basic.description:
{Basic Supremacy}

Combines the four elemental schools: your hero casts Fire, Air, Water and Earth spells at basic level, for reduced spell points.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Supremacy}

Combines the four elemental schools: your hero casts Fire, Air, Water and Earth spells at advanced level, for reduced spell points and with increased effect.

expert.description:
{Expert Supremacy}

Combines the four elemental schools: your hero casts Fire, Air, Water and Earth spells at expert level, for reduced spell points and with maximum effect.
